Class StudentIdPreferences

java.lang.Object
com.example.bluej.StudentIdPreferences
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.PreferenceGenerator
public class StudentIdPreferences extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.PreferenceGenerator
Author:
Ubayd Razack Adds a "Telemetry student ID" text input box to BlueJ's Tools -> Preferences -> Extensions panel.
